audit_items.proof_trace: The exchange_rate function (L92-101) directly implements the formula: numerator = cash_plus_borrows_minus_reserves() = debt.add_u64(cash).sub(cash_reserve) (= cash + debt - cash_reserve by commutativity), denominator = float::from(total_supply), result = numerator / denominator. The property is satisfied by construction. The subtraction cannot underflow because withdraw_underlying (L312-313) asserts cash >= cash_reserve.ceil() on every withdrawal path, and debt >= 0 always, guaranteeing cash + debt >= cash_reserve.
